patch_description: The current program (using CRY gates and extra RY mid-layer, 198 params) scored 0.60, worse than the earlier all-CRZ variant with shared params (162 params, score 0.63). Revert to that better-performing structure, then apply the recommended further parameter reduction: merge the CRZ on edge [4,8] (`crz_9`) into the CRZ on [3,5] (`crz_5`), and merge the CRZ on [6,7] (`crz_11`) into [5,7] (`crz_10`). This restores the higher-scoring architecture while trimming 2 more parameters (162 -> 160), testing whether the extra sharing preserves or improves the 0.63 combined score.
